key.name: auto-maximize
key.description: Whether to maximize application windows. This only affects Wayland applications and only their main window.

key.name: blur
key.summary: Blur the backdrop of surfaces that ask for it
key.description: Whether to blur what is behind a surface that requested background blur over the layer shell effects protocol, and behind a translucent window. Switching this off leaves those surfaces plainly translucent. Read at startup and followed while the compositor runs, so a device whose GL path misbehaves can turn the effect off without downgrading the compositor.

key.name: scale-to-fit
key.summary: Enable automatic scaling of all oversized windows
key.description: Whether to scale-to-fit all windows that are larger than the screen they're on.

key.name: scale-to-fit
key.summary: Enable automatic scaling of oversized windows
key.description: Whether to scale-to-fit windows belonging to this application that are larger than the screen they're on.
